title: Synopsys Scraped Transcript Materials
source_summary: Scraper-collected transcript or conference-call materials for Synopsys.
strengths: good bridge from reported numbers to interpretation
weaknesses: some transcript folders may include event-call materials that are not pure earnings-call Q&A
